notes: Rule 1: stabilise first for rice bran and before any wet step.
Rule 2: phytase before ae_iep (engineering judgement [A]; verify).
Rule 3: moist_heat -> phytase allowed only with cooling; phytase -> moist_heat forbidden.
Rule 4: ae_iep ends the chain; extrude after it only for meat analogue.
Rule 5: extrude first or last; never between phytase and ae_iep.
Rule 6: ssf_ferment and soak_germinate are mutually exclusive [A].
Rule 7: max length 4; each treatment at most once; exclusions and missing equipment removed first.
Rule 8: prune partial chains over the cost cap at P10 or with retention P90 below the requirement.
